about: Internet Archive (archive.org): a digital library of texts, audio, video, software and web snapshots. This CLI searches items, including full-text search inside books, browses collections and user uploads, reads item metadata, file lists, reviews and OCR text, downloads files, and queries Wayback Machine snapshots.

commands.summary: Keyword search across archive.org items, as the archive.org/search UI does it, with facet filters, sort and paging; set service_backend=fts to search inside book text

params.name: query
params.description: Search terms. Lucene-style field queries are allowed, e.g. 'grateful dead' or 'title:(moby dick)'

params.name: filter_map
params.description: JSON facet filter. Map each field to {value: op}, where op is inc, exc, gte or lte. Example: {"mediatype":{"texts":"inc"},"year":{"1900":"gte","1950":"lte"},"language":{"English":"inc"}}

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order as field:direction. Omit for relevance.

params.name: service_backend
params.description: Search backend: 'metadata' (the default when omitted) or 'fts' for full-text search inside documents

params.name: hits_per_page
params.description: Results per page (the UI uses 50 or 100)

params.name: page
params.description: 1-based page number

commands.summary: List the items in a collection (e.g. GratefulDead, texts, audio), with sort, facet filters and paging

params.name: collection
params.description: Collection identifier, e.g. GratefulDead, etree, texts, librivoxaudio

params.name: query
params.description: Optional search terms to search within the collection

params.name: filter_map
params.description: JSON facet filter, e.g. {"year":{"1977":"inc"}}

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order as field:direction

params.name: hits_per_page
params.description: Results per page

params.name: page
params.description: 1-based page number

commands.summary: List the public uploads of an archive.org user account

params.name: user
params.description: Account screen name prefixed with @, e.g. @matthew_vernon

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order as field:direction

params.name: hits_per_page
params.description: Results per page

params.name: page
params.description: 1-based page number

commands.summary: Solr-style advanced search (advancedsearch.php) returning identifier, title, creator, mediatype, date and downloads, with sort and paging

params.name: q
params.description: Lucene query, e.g. 'grateful dead AND mediatype:audio' or 'collection:GratefulDead AND year:1977'

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort as 'field asc|desc', e.g. 'downloads desc', 'date asc', 'publicdate desc'

params.name: rows
params.description: Results per page

params.name: page
params.description: 1-based page number

commands.summary: Bulk-list every item matching a query with the cursor-based scrape API; suited to enumerating large collections

params.name: q
params.description: Lucene query, e.g. collection:GratefulDead

params.name: api_fields
params.description: Comma-separated metadata fields to return (sent to the site as "fields"; clify's own --fields only shapes the output)

params.name: count
params.description: Items per request (minimum 100)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor from the previous response, used to fetch the next batch

commands.summary: Get an item's descriptive metadata (title, creator, date, collection, description and more) by identifier

params.name: identifier
params.description: Item identifier (the part after /details/)

commands.summary: List the files in an item, with name, format, size and checksums; pass a name to download-file

params.name: identifier
params.description: Item identifier

commands.summary: Get the user reviews (title, body, reviewer, stars, date) posted on an item

params.name: identifier
params.description: Item identifier

commands.summary: Get the full OCR plain text of a text item (book or document)

params.name: identifier
params.description: Identifier of a texts item

commands.summary: Download one file from an item (text files are returned as text)

params.name: identifier
params.description: Item identifier

params.name: file
params.description: File name as listed by list-item-files

commands.summary: Get view statistics for a collection over the last N days, broken down by country and region

params.name: collection
params.description: Collection identifier

params.name: days
params.description: Number of days to look back

commands.summary: Get a user's public item lists and the items each one contains

params.name: username
params.description: Account screen name without the leading @

commands.summary: List the top collections featured on the archive.org home page, with item counts

params.name: page
params.description: 1-based page number

params.name: count
params.description: Collections per page

commands.summary: Get total item counts per media type (texts, movies, audio, software, image, etree, tv, web)
Find the Wayback Machine snapshot of a URL closest to a given timestamp

params.name: url
params.description: URL or domain to look up, e.g. example.com

params.name: timestamp
params.description: Target time as YYYYMMDDhhmmss (a prefix is fine, e.g. 20100101). Omit to get the latest snapshot.

commands.summary: List Wayback Machine captures of a URL from the CDX index, optionally limited to a date range

params.name: url
params.description: URL to list captures for, e.g. example.com

params.name: from
params.description: Start of the range as a YYYYMMDDhhmmss prefix, e.g. 2010

params.name: to
params.description: End of the range as a YYYYMMDDhhmmss prefix, e.g. 2012

params.name: matchType
params.description: How to match the url

params.name: collapse
params.description: Collapse adjacent duplicate captures on a field, e.g. digest or timestamp:8 (one per day)

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)
